rotation_slot.description: A daypart rotation slot. Energy and mood are editorial rotation guidance for the DJ — never measured tempo claims.

explicit_policy.description: How the slot treats explicit-flagged tracks.

tracks.description: Track titles, each must match a tracks[].title in this pack.

track.description: One rotation-ready track. bpm/key/duration/isrc are NOT schema properties — omit unknown measurements rather than inventing them.

credits.description: Verified credits only (producer, mix/master, engineer, recorded-at).

dj_backsell.description: Back-sell line for the DJ — verified facts only.

dj_intro.description: Intro line for the DJ — verified facts only.

explicit.description: True/false per distributor metadata; omit when unknown.

rights_clearance.description: Licensing posture for this track. Never claim clean/instrumental/one-stop unless verified.

verified_facts.description: MANDATORY: at least one cited fact per track.

verified_fact.description: Fact-source citations are MANDATORY — nothing ships without a citation, an observation date, and a confidence label.

citation.description: Live URL (or 'internal' for first-party ops records) where the fact was observed.

description: Authoring contract for OPEN WAVE rotation packs (format cwi-openwave/v1). A pack is a machine-readable airplay rotation an agent-DJ loads in seconds and spins on any broadcast: daypart rotation slots, DJ intros/backsells, and per-track verified facts with MANDATORY citations. HARD RULE: no_paid_placement must be true — a pack that sells, guarantees, or prices airplay is not OPEN WAVE. Track-level bpm/key/duration/isrc fields are deliberately NOT in this schema: unknown measurements are omitted, never invented.

contact.description: Public contact for licensing and radio inquiries.

fact_source.description: Canonical fact set every verified_fact should be traceable to (e.g. the CWI Scoreboard Chip).

no_paid_placement.description: HARD RULE. true means: no submission fees, no per-submission credits, no paid adds, no guaranteed airplay, no payola-adjacent mechanics anywhere in the pack. Spins are opt-in and logged transparently.

title: CWI OPEN WAVE rotation pack
